questions.q: How can technology such as wearable heart-rate monitors benefit training?
options: By replacing the need for a coach completely
By providing accurate data to monitor and adjust intensity
questions.explain: Wearable technology gives accurate, objective data that helps performers train at the correct intensity.

questions.q: Why might a performer take performance-enhancing drugs such as anabolic steroids?
options: To increase muscle growth and train harder
To slow their heart rate for relaxation
questions.explain: Anabolic steroids are taken to increase muscle mass and allow harder training, but they are banned and harmful.

questions.q: Commercialisation in sport is the process of:
options: Treating sport as a product to make a profit
questions.explain: Commercialisation involves managing sport as a business to generate income, linked closely to the media and sponsorship.

questions.q: How can age affect participation in sport?
options: It has no effect on participation
Some activities suit certain ages and older people may have less mobility
Only the cost of membership matters
questions.explain: Age can affect participation through changing physical ability, suitability of activities and available time.

questions.explain: Deviance is behaviour such as cheating, doping or violence that breaks the moral or written rules of sport.

questions.q: The 'golden triangle' in sport refers to the relationship between:
questions.explain: The golden triangle describes the interdependent link between sport, the media and sponsorship/commercialisation.

questions.q: Hawk-Eye technology is mainly used in sport to:
options: Aid officials in making accurate decisions
questions.explain: Hawk-Eye helps officials make accurate decisions on close calls, improving fairness.

questions.q: A negative effect of the media's influence on sport is:
options: Loss of atmosphere when fewer fans attend live events
questions.explain: Demand for televised sport can reduce live attendance and focus coverage on a few popular sports.

questions.q: Wheelchair-accessible facilities are important for increasing participation among people with:
questions.explain: Suitable provision and access help remove barriers to participation for people with disabilities.

questions.q: Which is an example of gamesmanship?
options: Time-wasting to gain an advantage within the rules
questions.explain: Gamesmanship is stretching the rules to gain an advantage without actually breaking them.

questions.q: A benefit of sponsorship for a performer is that it:
options: Provides funding for equipment, coaching and travel
questions.explain: Sponsorship provides financial support that helps athletes afford training, coaching and competition.

questions.q: Which is a drawback of sponsorship for a performer?
options: Pressure to perform and behave well to keep the sponsor
questions.explain: Sponsorship can bring pressure to perform and maintain a positive image, with funding lost if standards drop.
